contracts.title: Dabartinės lietuvių kalbos tekstyno žodžių formų dažniniai sąrašai
contracts.reason: The aggregate has 1,733,157 rows. It is published as bounded static JSON chunks rather than loaded into the generic browser selector.

source.citation: Rimkutė, E., Kovalevskaitė, J., Melninkaitė, V., Utka, A., Vitkutė-Adžgauskienė, D. 2010. Corpus of Contemporary Lithuanian Language – the Standardised Way.

constraints: Fetch the aggregate or one selected subcorpus only after selection.
Use the published manifest and view index before requesting individual chunks.
Keep parsing, filtering, sorting, ranking, and export off the main thread when adding an interactive explorer.
Never add the aggregate count to the five subcorpus counts.
Expose token-count units and source corpus scope in every result.
A CCLL genre profile may join only the five named subcorpus lists; the aggregate and its alphabetical index are not genres and must remain excluded.
Keep each named subcorpus raw count and token denominator separate, and represent a missing wordform as not observed rather than zero.
Do not create a universal genre-signal leaderboard or ratio ranking without a separate documented stability review.

contracts.title: Dictionary of Modern Lithuanian coverage compared with JCL
contracts.reason: The source contains a JCL token count, a DML6 coverage code, a separate lemma occurrence list, and a missing-types list. Each is published as its own documented JSON view.

source.citation: Dadurkevičius, V., Petrauskaitė, R. 2020. Corpus based methods for assessment of the traditional dictionaries.

metrics.label: JCL occurrence count for lemma and part of speech

constraints: Render coverage codes as labelled categories, never as counts.
Keep the missing-types list separate from lemma occurrences.
Do not expose either comparison metric as the generic dataset frequency.

contracts.title: CCLL2 compared with wartime media and social-network lexicons
contracts.reason: The source has six normalized metrics, with missing values where a word is absent from one source. It is published as a null-preserving comparison JSON view.

source.citation: Utka, A. 2024. Comparative wordlist based on CCLL2 and wartime media and social-network lexicons.

constraints: Preserve null for an absent source metric; do not coerce it to zero.
Show normalized units and source denominators beside every metric.
Keep token and document metrics distinct.
Do not rank or export the six metrics as one total-frequency column.

contracts.title: Lithuanian 1-gram frequency list from the Delfi.lt corpus
contracts.reason: The source is a 1,030,562-row raw wordform frequency list. It is published as bounded static JSON chunks rather than loaded into the generic browser selector.

source.citation: Bielinskienė, A., Boizou, L., Bumbulienė, I., Kovalevskaitė, J., Krilavičius, T., Mandravickaitė, J., Rimkutė, E., Vilkaitė-Lozdienė, L. 2019. Lithuanian 1-gram dataset. Baltic Institute of Advanced Technology and Vytautas Magnus University. CLARIN-LT Repository. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11821/27.

constraints: Treat each source row as a raw one-gram token count, not as a lemmatised frequency.
Preserve the source token string, including punctuation and non-alphabetic forms.
Parse integer-valued scientific notation exactly before exposing numeric JSON counts.
Use the manifest and chunk index before requesting individual data chunks.

contracts.title: MATAS v3.0 derived lemma and wordform frequencies
contracts.reason: The reviewed CoNLL-U corpus can produce reproducible frequency views while retaining the source Universal POS value and clearly excluding punctuation from word-frequency totals.

source.citation: Rimkutė, E., Bielinskienė, A., Dadurkevičius, V., Kovalevskaitė, J., Utka, A., Boizou, L. 2024. Lithuanian morphologically annotated corpus — MATAS v3.0. Institute of Digital Resources and Interdisciplinary Research (SITTI), Vytautas Magnus University. CLARIN-LT Repository. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11821/61.

schema.derivation: Count integer-ID CoNLL-U rows by lemma or form plus Universal POS; exclude UPOS=PUNCT and map a missing UPOS to UNSPECIFIED.

constraints: Do not conflate this derived corpus frequency with the source's generic token total.
Exclude UPOS=PUNCT from both frequency views.
Preserve the Universal POS value; use UNSPECIFIED only where the source field is empty.
Keep lemma and wordform frequencies as separate views.

contracts.title: Lithuanian homoforms
contracts.reason: The public CC BY 4.0 TSV is a complete, structured homoform inventory. Its MATAS frequency and per-component frequency are retained as distinct source metrics rather than recast as one generic word-frequency ranking.

constraints: Keep the source's homoform, lemma, morphology, and type/subtype strings distinct.
Keep MATAS frequency and component frequency as separate raw source metrics.
Retain the source record order; it is not a consistently descending frequency ranking.

contracts.title: Foreign-name transliteration pairs
contracts.reason: The public CC BY 4.0 text file is a complete, reproducibly parseable list of source name pairs and source match counts. Source ordering and pair direction are retained literally because the source record warns about noise and inconsistent transliterations.

source.citation: Foreign-name transliteration data. 2025. CLARIN-LT Repository. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11821/68.

metrics.label: Source match count
metrics.unit: matches in the source corpus extraction

constraints: Expose the two source strings as left and parenthesized fields; do not silently infer a canonical foreign or Lithuanian ordering.
Treat sourceMatchCount as an extraction match count, not as a general Lithuanian-language frequency.
Retain the source record order and its documented noise or non-standard transliterations.

contracts.title: Lithuanian basketball slang lexical database
contracts.reason: The public CC BY 4.0 NVH lexical database is fully parseable into entries, source metadata, senses, definitions, examples, variants, and compiler fields. It is a crowdsourced lexicon, not a corpus frequency dataset.

source.citation: Lithuanian Basketball Slang Lexical Database. 2026. CLARIN-LT Repository. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11821/81.

schema.details: source, senses, definitions, examples, user groups, variants, and entry compilers

constraints: Do not present entries as corpus-frequency observations or rank them by popularity.
Preserve source, definition, example, variant, user-group, and compiler information where supplied.
Report 223 parsed top-level entries from the stored NVH file and preserve the source-record page's separate 233-entry claim.

contracts.title: Lithuanian Treebank ALKSNIS v3.0 syntactic contexts
contracts.reason: The reviewed CC BY treebank contains dependency heads, relation labels, sentence identifiers, and source genres. It can support bounded, source-scoped syntax contexts without treating its small annotated sample as a general language-frequency corpus.

source.citation: Rimkutė, E., Bielinskienė, A., Kovalevskaitė, J., Boizou, L., Aleksandravičiūtė, G., Brokaitė, K., and Utka, A. 2019. Lithuanian Treebank ALKSNIS. Vytautas Magnus University. CLARIN-LT Repository. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11821/21.

schema.key: source lemma plus a selected dependency role
schema.derivation: For every integer-ID non-punctuation CoNLL-U token, retain its source relation, head direction, document, genre, sentence identifier, and sentence text. Roots retain HEAD=0 as ROOT. A selected lemma receives at most the configured source-order examples.

constraints: Treat ALKSNIS as a finite annotated treebank, not as a generic frequency corpus or a thesaurus.
Keep source relation labels, dependency direction, source document, genre, and sentence identifier with every displayed context.
Exclude UPOS=PUNCT from the lemma index, relation summary, and context examples; do not infer a missing linguistic relation.
Keep roots explicit as HEAD=0 / ROOT rather than inventing a lexical head.
Do not claim statistically significant genre differences or generic similarity from this source-scoped sample.
Show at most the documented source-order context limit per lemma and disclose omitted rows.

contracts.title: Lithuanian Parliament Corpus corpus-wide frequency aggregates
contracts.reason: The reviewed aggregate outputs contain only corpus-wide wordform and lemma totals. They expose no raw text, excerpts, document records, speaker or author information, source identifiers, or temporal breakdowns, so they can support a clearly labelled legislative-language frequency product without an authorship feature.

source.citation: Kapočiūtė-Dzikienė, Jurgita, Šarkutė, Ligita, and Utka, Andrius. 2017. Lithuanian Parliament Corpus for Authorship Attribution. Vytautas Magnus University. CLARIN-LT Repository. https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.11821/17.

schema.derivation: Corpus-wide totals are retained from the reviewed privacy-safe aggregate outputs. The two views must stay separate because their source tokenization and lemmatisation totals differ.

constraints: Describe the product as a legislative-speech corpus, not as general Lithuanian language use.

Publish only corpus-wide wordform and lemma totals; do not add raw text, excerpts, sample sentences, document records, source identifiers, speaker or author names, rankings, or author-level statistics.
Do not add calendar, day, session, or speaker-level views without a separate documented disclosure review and minimum-cell policy tracked in issue #68.
Keep wordform and lemma counts as separate source-scoped measures; do not imply that either total is the repository's general corpus word-count claim.

tokenizer.normalization: NFC before segmentation, DuckDB simple Unicode lowercase per code point, then NFC for each token
tokenizer.boundary: A token is a maximal contiguous sequence matched by RE2 Unicode \p{L}+.

Do not publish raw text, document rows, document subtypes, crossed dimensions, titles, authors, URLs, source identifiers, publication dates, or personal data.
Retain the BLKT attribution, NewGenLTU OpenRAIL-D v1.0 licence, modification notice, downstream field-of-use restriction, and personal-data prohibition.
Retain the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence and Wikipedia-contributor attribution for the Vikipedija-labelled source subset, and make both complete licence texts available with the product.
State that BLKT is not representative of all Lithuanian language use because media and document texts dominate its composition.

method.normalization: Unicode NFC; source text otherwise preserved
method.rowOrder: PDF volume order I, II, III; page order; top-to-bottom order
method.continuationPolicy: A pure x >= 285 pt line is buffered: it is prepended to the next same-page row only when that row's description lacks a semicolon; otherwise it is appended to the preceding row, including across page boundaries.
method.splitFragmentPolicy: A reviewed non-row split line is joined to its adjacent row using source-layout direction; forward joins require the next row on the same page within 17 pt. Every split-line digest must match the manifest set.
